Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner changed the comparison criterion from the directors’ actual ages (birth years) to their ages at the time of each film’s release, despite having already established that A. B. Raj (1925/1929) is older than Amos Kollek (1947). This misinterpretation led to the incorrect conclusion that Kalippava has the younger director, whereas comparing birth years correctly shows A Couch In New York has the younger director.
